description: Evidence-lane output. Candidates are observations, not findings: no severity and no fix. A taste lane turns these into judged findings matching findings-schema.json.

evidence.description: Files, components, and states actually inspected. Not what was in scope.

candidates.description: One entry per suspected root cause. Deliberately has no severity and no `after`: assigning either is judgment, which happens in the taste lane.

observed.description: The current implementation, quoted or described exactly as found.

rule.description: The owning skill's principle or Common Mistakes row this appears to violate.

measurement.description: Any computed value that decides the case: a contrast ratio or Lc, a hit-area size, a line count.

confidence.description: How sure the lane is before a taste lane verifies it against source.

rejected.description: Candidates inspected and deliberately not raised. Required so restraint survives the lane boundary.

check.description: The exact command or interaction steps.

blocked.description: Anything in scope this lane could not inspect, or "None".
